scope.ingestionPolicy: Preserve 79 curated records: 57 overlays on eligible Reviewed records and 22 records outside the fixed scope. Only source id/aliases define identity. MAL and unmatched backlogs are not bulk imported.
scope.baselineRetrievalNote: Immutable GitHub Git Blobs API URLs return JSON envelopes with base64 content, not raw JSON/gzip file bodies. Decode content, verify the decoded-file SHA256, then decompress the inventory gzip. The historical source-snapshot bundle was not uploaded and remains unavailable; no unqualified relative link to it is supplied.

recovery.note: Three historical export generations were freshly fetched and matched the retained report SHA256 and bytes. Four unchanged current bodies match the same baseline hashes. Every current and recovered baseline ZIP member was read with CRC validation and canonical JSON compared. Lost later observations are not claimed as the comparison baseline. Historical JVN raw bodies remain unavailable.

limitations: Seven ecosystem exports have independent source update times; not all OSV or a single transactionally synchronized snapshot.

curatedBunApi.note: Existing curated records and withdrawal overrides preserved; no fresh API or maintainer recheck claimed.
